name: mnki-mcp
description: Puts Agent Trust in front of any MCP server: every tool call is checked against policy, with evidence, before it runs.
long_description: Agent Trust gives an AI agent an identity, bounded authority and proof of every consequential action. This extension wraps an MCP server you already use (GitHub, filesystem, a database, anything with a command) and verifies each tools/call against your organisation's policy before it reaches the server. Start in observe mode (nothing is blocked, would-be denials are logged), read the shadow log in the console, then switch to enforce. Denials come back to Claude with the evidence list; actions that policy escalates wait for a human approval on the Agent Trust phone app. Needs a free Agent Trust organisation at https://mnki.com and an API key with the verify scope.

upstream.title: MCP server to protect (command and arguments)
upstream.description: The command Claude Desktop would otherwise run for this server, one argument per line, e.g. npx / -y / @modelcontextprotocol/server-github.

agent.title: Agent identity
agent.description: The Agent Trust identity these tool calls run under (console → Agents, or `mnki identity create`).

server.title: Server name
server.description: How this server appears in the ledger and the shadow log.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe (log only, nothing blocked), warn, require_approval, or enforce.

console_url.title: Console URL
console_url.description: https://mnki.com, or your self-hosted control plane.

api_key.title: Agent Trust API key
api_key.description: A key with the verify scope (console → Settings → API keys). Stored in the OS keychain.
